description: The whole market's schedule from Nasdaq's public calendars: who reports earnings on given days (before the open or after the close, consensus EPS and number of estimates, last year's EPS), who goes ex-dividend (amount, record and payment dates), stock splits coming up, and a month's IPOs (priced, expected, filed, withdrawn); filter by tickers or market value.

days.description: How many days from date (earnings and dividends); default 1.

kind.description: earnings: who reports and the consensus EPS; dividends: who goes ex-dividend; splits: splits coming up; ipos: the month's IPOs, priced, expected, filed and withdrawn.

limit.description: Most rows; default 100, largest companies first for earnings.

min_market_cap.description: Earnings: only companies worth at least this many US dollars.

name: market_calendar

outputSchema.description: rows are earnings reports, ex-dividend dates or splits in the order of columns.

title: Market calendar: earnings, dividends, splits (Nasdaq)
